Hi Priya (and team),

Thanks for the clear recap; this looks right. A few clarifications on our side to help scope the evidence pack: 

1) SOC 2 status: we require vendor evidence of SOC 2 coverage for production services. Can you confirm Redwood's current status (Type I/Type II) and whether the activity logs export is in-scope for the report? Our procurement team prefers Type II but we can accept Type I if controls covering logging/export are documented.

2) HIPAA/GDPR: Luminate processes limited PHI during testing. We need written confirmation on encryption-at-rest/in-transit for logs and details on any processing in non-US regions.

3) Export formats & delivery: preferred formats are newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) or CSV. We need an option to push to an S3 bucket we manage (with dedicated prefix + KMS). What is the latency from event generation to export? Can exports include full request/response payloads for admin API calls?

4) Immutability: Our auditors will ask whether exported records can be made immutable (WORM) for a given retention period and whether there is a verifiable hash chain or signing for records.

5) Sample schema: please share an example of an admin_activity event with field definitions.

We can confirm the security questionnaire — attaching a short PDF of our intake questions separately (sending internally to security; expect a formal PDF by 2026-04-29). We also want to schedule the demo; 5/6 10am PT works for our engineering and security leads.

Thanks,
Samantha Ross

Hi Samantha — quick technical answers and an example payload below. Happy to expand in the demo.

SOC 2 / scope
- Redwood: SOC 2 Type II in production (report available under NDA). Admin/API logging and export processes are within scope for our logging and change-management controls. We will include the SOC 2 summary in the evidence pack Marissa will prepare.

Encryption / regional processing
- Logs: encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+).
- Processing: default processing happens in us-west-2 for your account; we can confirm region-specific processing for Private deployments if required.

Export delivery options
- Push to customer S3 (preferred): we support server-side encrypted (SSE-KMS) S3 uploads with customer-managed KMS key and prefix. Exports can be batched hourly or streamed in near-real-time (sub-minute) to signed URLs.
- Pull via API: NDJSON endpoint to request historic export slices (pagination + filters).
- Webhook/SQS: We can deliver a continuous stream to an authenticated endpoint or SQS.

Export contents & latency
- Included: timestamp, actor (internal user id/email), action type, resource id, request metadata (IP, user-agent), full request metadata (optional; can be redacted), response status, trace id.
- Latency: near-real-time streaming under light load; batched hourly by default for bulk exports (configurable).

Immutability options
- Immutable exports: we support generating exports into an S3 bucket with object lock (WORM) enabled. Additionally, we can produce a signed hash manifest (SHA-256) for each export file and an append-only ledger with signed records for forensic verification.

Sample admin_activity event (example)
{
  "event_time": "2026-04-29T10:59:23Z",
  "actor": "admin:j.smith@luminate-tx.com",
